component.summary: Create and edit plain text documents
सादा पाठ दस्तावेज़ बनाएँ और संपादित करें

description.p: Text Editor opens local plain text, Markdown, and rich text files in independent native document windows.
It combines focused writing controls with guarded saving, external-change detection, and recovery behavior.
